Everything You Need to Know About Calculating Wall Area

Learn the professional formulas used by painters and contractors to estimate wall surface without waste.

What is Wall Area?

Wall area is the total two-dimensional surface of vertical room walls. To avoid buying excess primer and paint, it is divided into Gross Wall Area (total boundaries) and Paintable Wall Area (excluding doors, windows, and cabinets).

How to Calculate Wall Area

For a standard 4-wall rectangular room, calculate the perimeter multiplied by ceiling height:
Area = 2 × (Length + Width) × Height.
For individual walls, simply multiply width by height.

Subtracting Doors & Windows

A typical door is 0.9m × 2.1m (~1.89 m² or 21 sq ft). A standard window is approximately 1.2m × 1.5m (~1.8 m²). Deducting these prevents over-purchasing 10% to 25% of paint on typical residential rooms.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How do I calculate wall area for an L-shaped room?

Switch to the "Multiple Walls" tab. Measure each of the distinct walls around the perimeter and add their width and height individually. The calculator will automatically sum the areas.

Does this calculator include the ceiling?

No, this tool focuses strictly on vertical walls. For ceilings, visit our dedicated Ceiling Calculator. You can combine both in the Paint Calculator.
